create_CP_model: create a CP knowledge base completion model with entity and relation embeddings for scoring triples
create_ComplEx_model: create a ComplEx model with complex-valued embeddings for scoring knowledge graph triples
run_get_ranking: run filtered ranking evaluation on KBC model queries using batched and chunked scoring
run_CP_score: run the CP model score method to compute triple scores via element-wise embedding products
run_ComplEx_score: run the ComplEx model score method to compute triple scores using complex number arithmetic
